content:
[Verse 1]
[B5]Entering hellbound domini-
on. Acid rain. Human
modification. Hades glows red
hot. Howling mind accelerates.
Trapped in this time knot. Place there
is none: We go
backward and forward.
And there is no place.
[B5]Horror or infinity. In-
ternal draught Floor a temp-est.
Sanitorium?
Who are you? Why are you here?
No chemical aid.
No keys. No doords.
Walls or locks. Wing dipped
phoenix. Ashes: you asshole!
